title: Grilled Tofu Yakitori
description: A Japanese-inspired grilled tofu skewer dish, flavored with umami and unique seasonings. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: 1. Cut tofu into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together sake, mirin, soy sauce, gochujang, brown sugar, and Japanese biryani.
3. Place tofu cubes in a shallow dish and brush the sake mixture evenly over the tofu.
4. Let the tofu marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
5. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
6. Thread the marinated tofu cubes onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
7. Brush the grill or grill pan with oil to prevent sticking.
8. Grill the tofu skewers for 3-4 minutes per side, or until nicely charred.
9. Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
10. Serve with steamed rice or noodles, if desired.
